name: expense-api

dependencies.name: email-service
dependencies.description: Sends the notification emails: to a manager when a claim is submitted, to an employee when it is approved or rejected.

description: The single backend for claims, approvals, policy limits, people and payroll exports. It owns all business data, receipt files included, in its Postgres database, enforces the rules (submit checks against category maximums and the manager assignment, one decision per claim, export at most once, receipts images or PDF up to 10 MB), resolves 'my' and 'my team' rows from the gateway assertion, and sends notification emails. One service because every feature works on the same claim records and is deployed and scaled together; it does not serve the UI or sign users in.
